round 17: HEIC compatibility — every Edit-mode pipeline + preview now reads from the decoded-JPEG path, not the raw HEIC blob. Round 11 only patched _editState.originalFile; the companion originalUrl was still f.url (raw HEIC blob URL — unrenderable in Chrome/Firefox/Edge) and saveEdit's `workingBlob = f.file` fed the raw HEIC into every _applyX helper's createImageBitmap, causing the InvalidStateError captured in round 16's note. Fixes (single coherent commit, browser-native only, zero new deps): (a) openEditMode mints a dedicated decoded-blob URL when f.decodedBlob exists and stores it as originalUrl, tracked via _editState._decodedOwnUrl so cancelEdit revokes it. Non-HEIC: _decodedOwnUrl=null, originalUrl=f.url (unchanged). (b) saveEdit initial blob: `let workingBlob = _editState.originalFile || f.file;` — one line, fixes rotate/adjust/crop/vignette/pixelate/blur/text on HEIC. (c) saveEdit filename: when newName ends in .heic/.heif, rewrite extension to .jpg (for image/jpeg) or .png (for image/png) so the downloaded file's name matches the bytes inside. (d) _renderRotateTab line 6094: background-image url → originalUrl || f.url. (e) _renderAdjustTab line 7114: _adjSrcUrl chain → autoEnhancedUrl || originalUrl || f.url. (f) _renderCropTab line 7368: createImageBitmap source → originalFile || f.file. (g) _renderBackgroundTab line 6741: origThumb.src → originalUrl. (h) _renderBackgroundTab line 6796: transformers.js pipe input → originalUrl, so RawImage.read sees a renderable JPEG instead of HEIC. Live verification on demo_3.heic (1.6 MB, decodes to 813 KB JPEG, 2400×1600): adjust+brightness save in 1.06s → demo_3.jpg 1.05 MB 2400×1600, decodable. rotate-90+crop save in 2.10s → demo_3.jpg 410 KB 1000×800, decodable. Regression test on a synthetic PNG: _decodedOwnUrl=null, originalUrl===f.url unchanged, rotate-180 save completes in 1.01s, filename/type/size preserved. Mobile (380×780 in-page pin): preview col 380×330, tabs horizontal-scroll (427>379), HEIC decoded URL feeds every preview (rotate bg, crop 372×248, pixelate/blur/text 380×253). node --check on extracted inline JS (320 KB) returns 0. Three commits inside one coherent change: (a) index.html b32be677877a — replaced `.edit-tabs { flex-wrap:wrap }` with `flex-wrap:nowrap; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none;` + hidden ::-webkit-scrollbar; tightened `.edit-tab` from `padding:5px 10px; font-size:.78rem;` to `padding:5px 8px; font-size:.75rem;` with `flex-shrink:0; white-space:nowrap;` (reduced total tab content from 395px to 356px). Added `.edit-tabs--overflow-l/r` mask-image rules (Material 3 / Carbon edge-fade convention — https://m3.material.io/components/tabs/guidelines + https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/tabs/usage/). Added 3 JS helpers: `_updateTabsOverflow()` toggles the overflow classes based on scrollLeft+clientWidth vs scrollWidth; `_scrollActiveTabIntoView()` brings the active tab into view; `_wireTabsOverflowWatcher()` (idempotent) registers scroll + resize listeners. Wired into `_switchEditTab` via rAF schedule. (b) index.html d2d3a9a1934b — replaced `scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest',behavior:'smooth'})` with direct `bar.scrollLeft = aR - cw + 6` math after Chrome diagnostic showed scrollIntoView's smooth queue was being canceled by the synchronous _render*Tab DOM work that follows in _switchEditTab. _updateTabsOverflow still ran correctly via the rAF chain, but the scrollLeft change kept bouncing back. (c) index.html a2bc5e4e4cf8 — widened `.edit-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr 300px }` -> `1fr 380px` so all 7 tabs (total ~356px content + ~20px padding = ~376px) fit in one row without any scroll on desktop. Preview col goes from 1620 -> 1540 (still huge at any standard viewport). The mobile @media <=640 override is unchanged (grid-template-columns:1fr), so mobile is unaffected. Verified live (cv=imgready-2092d849c78d): desktop 1920x917 - panelW=380, previewW=1540, all 7 tabs single-row (rows=1), each tab x/width within bar's bounding box (allVisibleByX=true), no horizontal scroll needed (overflowing reports true because scrollWidth 389 vs clientWidth 379 from the 10px residual padding, but all tab rects are fully inside the bar rect). Each tab click activates + renders body (bodyOk=true for all 7). Mobile (380x780 pinned): cardW=380 cardH=780, panelW=380 panelH=354, previewW=380 previewH=330, tabBarW=379 tabBarScroll=389 (single row, h-scroll preserved), all 7 tab clicks activate + render. No app-side console errors. Background tab spot-check at the widened panel: BG-mode-toggle pill stretches to 355px, Remove-background button stretches to 355px, copy preserves the round-16 sentence-case text. Net positive on desktop: yes (2-row wrap -> 1-row, all 7 tabs always visible, ~30px vertical reclaimed from the tab-bar area). Net positive on mobile: yes (literally no behavior change — mobile's grid-template-columns override neutralizes the panel widening; the new edge-fade and overflow classes coexist with mobile's existing h-scroll). Regressions: none — no JS errors, no layout overflow, no copy loss. Zero new external dependencies (browser-native CSS mask-image + flexbox + scrollLeft math). Research sources: Material 3 Tabs (Apache-2.0 docs), Carbon Tabs (Apache-2.0 docs), NN/g Tabs Used Right + Icon Usability, Photopea Workspace, Pixlr E Toolbar. index.html commits: b32be677877a -> d2d3a9a1934b -> a2bc5e4e4cf8. sw.js commits: 6bd5780cd713 -> 0d9cbc140ab7 -> 2092d849c78d. resolved_rounds.note: Root cause was twofold: (1) saveEdit's workingBlob initialised from f.file (raw HEIC) so every photo-edit _applyX helper's createImageBitmap call threw InvalidStateError, and (2) _editState.originalUrl was f.url (HEIC blob URL, unrenderable in Chrome/Firefox/Edge) so the rotate-tab background, adjust-tab , crop-tab createImageBitmap, BG-tab origThumb, and the transformers.js pipe URL input all broke. Fixed by minting a decoded-blob URL in openEditMode, routing every preview/pipeline through originalUrl/originalFile, and renaming the saved file extension when the encoded output's MIME no longer matches .heic/.heif.
